interface: Native single-outstanding CSR: 8-bit byte address, 32-bit data, clk_en-qualified handshakes
clock: GPIO/PWM/timer/IRQ state follows CE; UART/SPI/I2C/QSPI/SD serial engines and timeouts run continuously on physical clk; CE gates CSR only
reset: rst_n active-low asynchronous reset aborts outstanding commands and responses
verification_status: PASS: 20261015T125128_003142Z grouped aggregate compile and two pin-level simulations; synthesis and board tests not run
golden_source: Independent UART source/sink, SPI slave, I2C open-drain slave, QSPI flash and SD-SPI card models; legacy basic-core evidence retained

modules.name: common_gpio
limitations: No pad primitives or pin constraints
No debounce or edge interrupt
Synchronization sampling follows clk_en; short input pulses may be missed
No physical CDC validation

modules.name: common_pwm
limitations: Configuration writes restart phase immediately
No shadow update at period boundary
No deadtime, complementary outputs or fault shutoff
Frequency is clk_en tick rate divided by period

modules.name: common_timer
limitations: No independent prescaler or capture/compare
Time is counted in clk_en ticks
Reconfiguration restarts counting
No real-time behavior while clk_en is paused

modules.name: common_irq
limitations: No level-sensitive mode, priority encoder or vector claim/complete
Narrow pulses can be missed
No physical CDC validation

modules.name: common_uart
limitations: No FIFO, parity, flow control or fractional baud
RX mailbox preserves older byte on overflow
Runtime divisor changes only while TX/RX idle

modules.name: common_spi_master
limitations: No FIFO, DMA or LSB-first mode
Single active transfer; native CSR stalls until transfer response
capabilities: manual and cross-byte held chip select

modules.name: common_i2c_master
limitations: Host sends address/RW byte and sequences transactions
No automatic retries or nine-clock bus recovery
No full multi-master clock synchronization
External pad open-drain adapter/pull-ups required
capabilities: arbitration-lost detection when transmitted 1 is observed low

modules.name: common_qspi_controller

parameters.CPOL: idle SCK level; default 0; CPHA fixed 0

limitations: No DDR, DQS, XIP, DMA or QPI instruction/address lanes
Host configures device-specific QE/write-enable/commands/dummy/page limits
Read/dummy releases all DQ; board must provide appropriate pulls
No automatic flash busy polling or page splitting
capabilities: single chip-select transaction and completion response

modules.name: common_sd_spi

parameters.RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_TICKS: bounded response/busy/init waits; default 65535; see SD_SPI_REGISTERS.md

limitations: No SD v1/MMC, SD native bus, multi-block transfers, filesystem or DMA
Board card-detect and IO constraints required
Initialization requires suitable <=400kHz initial SCLK; host must choose divider
Start command acknowledges acceptance; host polls explicit completion/error status
capabilities: SD v2 SPI power-up clocks and CMD0/CMD8/CMD55/ACMD41/CMD58 initialization
SDSC CMD16 and byte addressing; SDHC block addressing
single-block CMD17 read and CMD24 write
